features: Smart Full-Color night vision with auto IR (25m)
release_notes: Bullet 3 Pro 3MP (IPC-S3EN-3V0W): active-deterrence full-color Wi-Fi 6 bullet, DC-only (no PoE). Specs from Imou's official datasheet (Rev 1.0.0). Distinct S3E family from the plain Bullet 3 (IPC-S3EP). FOV, min-lux and IK not stated. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: resolution 1920x1080 -> 2304x1296 (3MP, per the spec page; the combined 3MP/5MP datasheet misprints 1920x1080), added FOV 2.8mm 96 H / 52 V / 111 D and 3.6mm 78 H / 41 V / 91 D, added model code IPC-S3EP-3V0W; the spec page and datasheet disagree on night-vision range (30 vs 25 m), power (<12 vs <9 W) and weight (265 vs 290 g), so those were left as the datasheet states.

frigate.notes: ONVIF is officially listed for this model; IMOU uses the Dahua protocol so the RTSP path follows the Dahua realmonitor convention but is not independently verified on this SKU.

home_assistant.notes: IMOU uses the Dahua protocol; the ONVIF integration works.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile — IMOU uses the Dahua protocol.
